policy.policyChange: No adaptation cap, score anchor, weight, threshold, pin, source decision, or control changes. Round 2 changes nomination identities, restarts the invalid ordering, and binds candidate-neutral positive-PNG, C7 proof, and normalized-package measurement corrections that enforce existing G7, C7, and C9 requirements.
preMeasurementRules: Freeze and independently approve every allowed seed outcome, exact patch, result tree, concern map, owner ledger, candidate assessment, and candidate set before any round-2 native or performance collection.

Candidate-specific adapter, provider, driver, build, generated, test, documentation, and packaging code counts in that candidate regardless of repository location; moving code cannot improve a rating or evade a cap.

A changed candidate result tree, provider semantics, frozen protocol, or scoring input after collection starts requires a new universe version and a complete rerun; round 2 has no repair-after-result exception.
Logical concerns remain independently regressible behaviors and may not be merged, renamed, or omitted to gain admission or a score.

A candidate must pass every fixture and native lane; no assertion-count inflation, fixture exception, expected-state lookup, unsupported action, normalized-artifact substitute, or candidate-supplied evidence claim is accepted.
The explicit no-winner outcome remains valid; no cap or rating is raised merely to force a selection.

reuseAllowed: Byte-identical frozen protocols, controls, pins, source archives, source-review facts, and generated fixtures may be reused only after their recorded SHA-256 values are reverified.
Exact prior patch bytes may be used as starting inputs, but every round-2 result tree, metric ledger, owner estimate, and approval is regenerated.
reuseForbidden: No round-1 functional, security, performance, package, native-lane, score, approval, or decision record is round-2 evidence.
No provisional result may change a cap, score anchor, gate, weight, threshold, pin, source decision, control, fixture expectation, or normalization rule.
